page.notes: The bottom right reads "11 Pro-". I read "Pro-" as the catchword; "11" may be a signature or a verse number, and I am not certain which. The printed asterisk in the text ("vide *Apo-") matches the left margin note "*Et Apoc.19. v.20.21.", which I have placed beside "carnalia".
